title: CRM & Lead Manager
description:
**Role overview**  
The CRM \& Lead Manager is responsible for capturing every lead generated from Meta (Facebook / Instagram ) ads, Indiamart and Alibaba, qualifying them quickly, and handing them off to the right outlet sales executive for closure. This person owns the full lead lifecycle \- from the moment a form is filled on an ad to the point of first sales contact. They also maintain the CRM database, track follow\-up status, and report lead conversion metrics to the COO weekly.

**Lead flow this role manages**  
Meta Ad Lead/ Indiamart Lead/ Alibaba Lead→CRM Entry→Qualification Call→Assign to Sales Exec→Track \& Follow\-up→Closure / Report

**Key responsibilities**

**Lead capture \& CRM entry** \- Pull leads from Meta Ads Manager / lead form integrations daily (morning). Enter each lead into CRM (Zoho, Leadsquared, Google Sheet, or WhatsApp CRM) with source, product interest, location, and contact details. Zero lead should be missed.  
**First response \& qualification** \- Call or WhatsApp every new lead within 30 minutes of capture. Understand their requirement — product type, quantity, location, timeline, and budget. Tag leads as Hot / Warm / Cold based on the conversation.  
**Lead assignment to sales executives** \- Route qualified leads to the nearest franchise outlet's sales executive based on the lead's location. Share all lead details on WhatsApp or CRM. Confirm the executive has received and will follow up.  
**Follow\-up tracking** \- Monitor whether assigned sales executives have followed up within the agreed TAT. Send daily reminders for pending follow\-ups. Escalate unattended leads to the Sales Coordinator or MD after 24 hours.  
**Lead nurturing for cold leads \-** For leads that are not ready to buy immediately, maintain a follow\-up schedule \- weekly check\-ins via WhatsApp or call. Share product brochures, price lists, or offers to keep them engaged.  
**CRM database management** \- Keep the CRM updated at all times \- lead status, last contact date, next follow\-up date, and outcome. Ensure no lead is left stale for more than 7 days without an update.  
**Weekly lead MIS report** \- Prepare and share a weekly report covering: total leads received, leads by source / campaign, qualification rate, assignment status, and conversion rate by outlet. Present to MD every Monday.  
**Ad feedback to marketing** \- Based on lead quality patterns (wrong locations, irrelevant queries, low\-quality leads), share weekly feedback with whoever manages Meta Ads to improve targeting and ad creative.

**Key performance indicators**  
First response time \- Within 30 mins of lead capture  
Lead entry accuracy \- 100% leads logged, zero missed  
Lead\-to\-visit conversion \-Target: 20–30% of qualified leads  
CRM hygiene \-No lead stale beyond 7 days  
Follow\-up compliance \- Sales exec follow\-up within 2 hrs of assignment  
Weekly MIS \- Submitted every Monday, no delays

**Requirements**

**Must\-have**

* Graduate in any discipline
* 1–3 years in lead management / tele\-sales / CRM role
* Confident on calls \- Hindi \& Gujarati fluency
* Experience using CRM tools or structured tracking
* Proficient with WhatsApp Business \& Excel / Sheets
* Quick response mindset \- speed is critical in this role

**Good to have**

* Experience with Zoho CRM, Leadsquared, or similar
* Familiarity with Meta Ads lead forms / integrations
* Knowledge of farming or construction product categories
* Experience coordinating with a field sales team
* Basic understanding of sales funnel and conversion metrics

**Reporting \& working conditions**

* Reports to: COO / Sales Coordinator
* 6 days a week, office\-based
* Location: Admin HQ
* Coordinates with all outlet sales executives
* High call and WhatsApp volume daily
* Works closely with Meta Ads manager

**Perks**  
Per\-lead incentive

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across **Social Media, SEO, Performance Marketing, Content, Lead Generation and Analytics**, while also acting as the primary point of coordination between clients and internal teams.

This is not a purely social media execution role. We are looking for someone who understands **overall digital marketing and can manage campaigns and client requirements end\-to\-end.**

**Client \& Account Management**

* Manage day\-to\-day communication and relationships with assigned clients.
* Understand client requirements, business objectives and marketing goals.
* Develop and maintain digital marketing plans aligned with client objectives.
* Coordinate with Social Media, Content, Design, Performance Marketing and SEO teams to ensure timely execution.
* Conduct regular client discussions and provide campaign updates, insights and recommendations.
* Handle client feedback, revisions and escalations professionally.
* Identify opportunities to improve client performance and account growth.

**Social Media Management**

* Develop and execute social media strategies across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and X.
* Plan monthly content calendars based on brand objectives and audience behaviour.
* Coordinate with content writers, designers and video editors for content production.
* Monitor engagement, reach, follower growth and other relevant social media KPIs.
* Stay updated with platform trends, formats and algorithm changes.

**SEO**

* Understand basic to intermediate SEO principles, including:
* Keyword research
* On\-page SEO
* Technical SEO basics
* Competitor analysis
* Content optimisation
* Internal linking
* Search Console and organic performance
* Coordinate with SEO teams and understand how SEO contributes to overall digital growth.

**Performance Marketing**

* Have a working understanding of **Google Ads and Meta Ads**.
* Understand campaign objectives, targeting, budgets and key metrics such as:
* CPC
* CTR
* CPL
* Conversion Rate
* ROAS
* Coordinate with Performance Marketing teams and communicate campaign performance to clients.
* Understand lead\-generation and conversion campaigns and identify areas for optimisation.

**Digital Marketing \& Analytics**

* Understand overall digital marketing funnels from **awareness → engagement → lead generation → conversion**.
* Monitor website and campaign performance using tools such as **GA4, Google Search Console and Meta Ads Manager**.
* Analyse campaign reports and convert data into actionable insights.
* Track key account KPIs and prepare regular performance reports.
* Conduct competitor and market research to identify new opportunities.

What We're Looking For

* **1–5 years of experience** in Social Media, Digital Marketing, Account Management or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of **overall digital marketing**, not just social media.
* Working knowledge of **SEO and Performance Marketing**.
* Good communication and client\-handling skills.
* Ability to understand business objectives and translate them into marketing activities.
* Strong coordination and project\-management skills.
* Comfortable working with multiple clients and internal teams simultaneously.
* Data\-driven approach with the ability to understand and explain marketing KPIs.
* Good command of written and spoken English.

Good to Have

* Experience handling multiple client accounts.
* Experience with digital marketing agencies.
* Knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4 and Google Search Console.
* Experience with lead\-generation campaigns.
* Experience working with WordPress or other CMS platforms.
* Familiarity with tools such as Canva, Trello, Asana or similar project\-management platforms.

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

Someone who can **understand the client's business, coordinate the right internal teams, understand what is happening across digital channels, and communicate clear recommendations to the client.**

If you are someone who enjoys **social media but also wants to work across SEO, Performance Marketing, Content, Analytics and Client Management**, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Organic Growth Manager – SEO & AI Search
description:
**What You Will Own**

You will own organic growth across Ebizfiling’s priority business verticals, including:

* Company Registration in India
* LLP, OPC and Section 8 Registration
* Annual Filings and Compliance
* GST, Income Tax and Accounting
* Retainer Compliance Services
* Indian Subsidiary and Foreign\-Owned Company Registration
* USA Company Registration
* Trademark and other business compliance services

Your responsibility goes beyond rankings and traffic. You should be able to identify which searches have commercial value, which pages generate qualified leads, where Ebizfiling is losing visibility, and what should be prioritised to improve business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Organic Growth Strategy**

* Build and execute an organic growth strategy aligned with Ebizfiling’s priority services and revenue goals.
* Identify opportunities based on commercial intent, lead potential, competitive landscape and achievable upside.
* Prioritise high\-value opportunities instead of chasing search volume for its own sake.
* Create measurable growth plans for priority service pages, content clusters and emerging search opportunities.
* Strengthen topical and category authority across registrations, taxation, accounting and compliance.

**2\. SEO \& Search Performance**

* Improve visibility across high\-intent commercial, transactional and informational searches.
* Analyse search demand, SERPs, competitors, keyword opportunities and content gaps.
* Improve existing service pages, landing pages, blogs and knowledge content based on user intent and business value.
* Identify and resolve keyword cannibalisation, thin content, duplicate content, weak internal linking and underperforming high\-potential pages.
* Build strategies around user intent and conversion potential rather than rankings alone.

**3\. AI Search \& Generative Discovery**

Search is expanding beyond traditional Google results. You should understand how visibility is evolving across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and other AI\-powered search and answer platforms.

* Develop strategies for Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and AI Search visibility.
* Improve entity authority, semantic relevance, structured answers, source credibility and AI\-readable content architecture.
* Identify opportunities for Ebizfiling to become a trusted source that search engines and AI systems can surface, reference and recommend.
* Track and test changes in AI\-driven discovery and adapt the organic strategy accordingly.

**4\. Lead Generation \& Conversion**

SEO at Ebizfiling is treated as a customer\-acquisition channel, not a traffic\-only function.

**THE FUNNEL**

Search → Landing Page → Engagement → Enquiry → Qualified Lead → Customer

* Identify high\-traffic pages that fail to generate enquiries or qualified leads.
* Improve conversion paths, calls to action and service\-page journeys.
* Identify high\-intent queries with weak commercial outcomes and diagnose why.
* Convert relevant informational traffic into commercial opportunities without compromising content usefulness.
* Measure lead quality and business contribution, not just traffic volume.

**5\. Content, Authority \& Accuracy**

* Lead search\-intent mapping, content\-gap analysis, topic clustering, content briefs and content upgrades.
* Improve internal linking, FAQs, structured answers and content consolidation.
* Regularly identify outdated pages affected by changes in laws, government forms, filing requirements, due dates, fees, tax provisions, thresholds or compliance procedures.
* Prefer improving valuable existing assets over publishing large volumes of low\-value content.
* Work with subject\-matter and internal teams to ensure content remains accurate, useful and commercially relevant.

**6\. AI\-Assisted SEO**

* Use AI tools for research, search\-intent analysis, competitor intelligence, content\-gap discovery, topic clustering, briefs, FAQs, internal\-linking opportunities, data analysis and experimentation.
* Build efficient AI\-assisted workflows without compromising accuracy, originality or subject expertise.
* Know where AI improves productivity and where human judgement is essential.
* Avoid mass\-generated commodity content that adds little value to users or the brand.

**7\. Technical SEO**

* Diagnose crawling, indexation, canonicalisation, redirect and sitemap issues.
* Review structured data, robots directives, Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile SEO and site architecture.
* Identify duplicate\-content and JavaScript\-related SEO issues where relevant.
* Work effectively with developers and ensure recommended technical fixes are implemented correctly.

**8\. Analytics \& Competitive Intelligence**

* Use Search Console, analytics and SEO platforms to identify opportunities, diagnose losses and measure outcomes.
* Analyse which competitors are gaining visibility, why their pages outperform ours and where they remain vulnerable.
* Connect organic performance to enquiries, lead quality and revenue wherever tracking permits.
* Translate SEO data into clear actions and business priorities.

**Tools \& Platforms**

Strong hands\-on experience with a practical combination of the following is expected:

* Google Search Console and Google Analytics / GA4
* Ahrefs, Semrush, Ubersuggest or similar SEO research platforms
* Screaming Frog and technical SEO tools
* PageSpeed Insights and Google Trends
* Looker Studio or similar analytics/reporting tools
* ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity or comparable AI platforms

**WHAT MATTERS**

Knowing the tools is expected. Knowing what decisions to make from the data is what matters.

**Experience \& Candidate Profile**

* **Minimum experience:** At least 2 years of hands\-on experience in SEO, Organic Growth, Search Growth or a closely related role.
* **Evidence of impact:** You should be able to explain measurable improvements you personally influenced—traffic quality, leads, conversions, revenue, visibility or similar outcomes.
* **Commercial thinking:** You understand that useful organic growth is about capturing the right demand, not maximising vanity metrics.
* **AI awareness:** You actively understand how AI is changing search, content discovery and user behaviour.
* **Ownership:** You can independently identify problems, prioritise opportunities, test solutions and measure results.
* **Analytical mindset:** You are comfortable working with data and questioning assumptions.

Strong capability and demonstrated ownership matter more to us than the exact number of years on a résumé.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year
